fixture.summary: Meters: cpuSeconds (limit 3600; reserving 600 at a claim; counted per UTC day). A reservation fits while used plus reserved plus the amount is within the limit, here and in each enclosing scope; it is made under the active lease and settled when the lease ends.

errors.commonCorrection: Wait for reservations to settle or the day to pass, raise the limit with setLimit, or take other work; details.scope names where it did not fit.
Settle the reservation held through the old scope first.

reserve.useWhen: Use to reserve budget before work: with no meter, every meter's configured amount (cpuSeconds). It needs the active lease; a claim reserves for you.
reserve.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to ask whether it would fit; call checkReserve.
reserve.success: Returns what it reserved, by meter.

errors.commonCorrection: Wait for reservations to settle or the day to pass, raise the limit with setLimit, or take other work; details.scope names where it did not fit.
Settle the reservation held through the old scope first.
Acquire the lease, or claim the instance, then reserve.

checkReserve.useWhen: Use to ask whether reserve would fit now, here and in every scope, without reserving.
checkReserve.success: Returns fits, until (the next UTC day when that alone makes it fit, else null) and the scopes it read.

recordUsage.useWhen: Use to record what the work used, by meter; it is never refused for its amount, and releases the reservation it covers.
recordUsage.success: Returns used, what it released, and the overruns: each instance up the chain now over its limit.

settle.useWhen: Use to release what the instance's own reservations hold; the end of a lease settles them too.
settle.success: Returns what it released, by meter.

setLimit.useWhen: Use to raise or lower a meter's limit; it needs permission jobs.budget, and never goes below what is used and reserved.
setLimit.success: Returns the meter, its limit and the one before.

errors.commonCorrection: Name a limit at or above what is used and reserved; details.committed says how much.

reserveFor.doNotUseWhen: Do not call it yourself: an instance inside this scope calls it on its scope, as its reserve, settle and recordUsage run.

full.summary: Meters: cpu (limit the instance's cap, else 80; reserving the instance's estimate, else 60 at a claim; drawn from the scope its run link points at; counted per UTC day); calls (no limit); gpu (limit 10; drawn from the scope its pool link points at); disk (limit the instance's quota; drawn from the scope its run link points at). A reservation fits while used plus reserved plus the amount is within the limit, here and in each enclosing scope; it is made under the active lease and settled when the lease ends. Usage over a limit sends directive meterExceeded to the lease holder and moves status from running or queued to failed.
